terms.title: Terms of use
terms.whoBody: AYWO ("Across Years, We're One") is published by {{company}}, CIN {{cin}}, registered office {{address}}. Contact: {{email}}, {{website}}.
terms.accountBody: You sign in with your mobile number and a one-time code. Keep your phone safe, because whoever holds it can sign in as you. One person, one account. You must give true details and be old enough to agree to these terms where you live. Anyone under 18 needs a parent or guardian's consent.
terms.familyBody: What you add stays yours. You give AYWO permission to store it and show it to the people you share it with, only to run the service. The tree itself is free. You can download a copy of it at any time.
terms.othersBody: A family tree holds details of other people, some of them living. Add only what is true and what you believe they would be comfortable with. Do not add anyone's contact details without their agreement. Do not use AYWO to harass, mislead or harm anyone, to send advertising, or to collect details about people.
terms.plusBody: AYWO Plus is a paid subscription for a family of up to six. Inside the apps it is sold through Apple or Google, and on the web through Razorpay or Stripe. It renews on its own until you cancel. Cancel in the store or on the web where you bought it: deleting your account does not cancel it. A free trial, where offered, turns into a paid plan unless cancelled before it ends. Our Return and refund policy explains when you get money back.
terms.removalTitle: Asking for something to be removed
terms.removalBody: Anyone added to a tree without agreeing can ask for removal through the takedown form, with or without an account. AYWO Admins review these requests and may remove a person from a tree.
terms.endingBody: You can delete your account in the app at any time. A tree you created passes to its successor or a Co-creator, and with neither it is closed. We may block an account that breaks these terms.
terms.liabilityBody: AYWO is offered as it is. Family details come from families, and relationship words may be wrong, so please don't rely on them for legal, medical or inheritance matters. The SOS and alert features depend on your phone and network: they do not replace emergency services. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect loss.
terms.changesBody: We may change these terms. When a change matters, we will tell you in the app and ask you to agree again before it applies to you.
terms.lawBody: These terms follow the laws of India, and the courts in {{courtCity}} hear any dispute. Nothing here removes rights you have under consumer law. Questions and complaints: {{email}}. Grievance Officer: {{grievanceOfficer}}, {{grievanceEmail}}.
terms.ordersBody: Some things can be bought once: a printed family tree poster, a printed family book and premium invite designs. The price, including any tax and delivery charge, is shown before you pay. You are responsible for the details printed, so please check them first. Delivery, returns and refunds follow our Return and refund policy.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.whoBody: {{company}}, CIN {{cin}}, registered office {{address}}, runs AYWO and decides how your data is used. Privacy contact: {{email}}. Grievance Officer: {{grievanceOfficer}}, {{grievanceEmail}}.
privacy.collectBody: Your mobile number, name, photo, language and settings. What you and your relatives add to a family tree: names, dates, places, photos, notes and relationships. Your messages, memories, invitations and comments in the app. Whether you pay for AYWO Plus, though never your card or bank details. A delivery address, if you order something printed. A device token, so we can send notifications. Basic technical records, such as IP address, to keep the service safe.
privacy.contactsBody: Your login number is used for signing in and for finding you in a tree someone has already saved you in. We never show it to anyone. Phone numbers and emails on a person's card are shown only to those the tree's rules allow, and they never appear in history, logs, notifications or lists.
privacy.shareBody: Only the people a tree is shared with, at the level its Creator or Co-creator chose. Someone with a shared link sees names and photos only. We don't sell your data, we don't show advertising, and AYWO's staff see tree contents only when needed to handle a request, with a written reason on record.
privacy.providersBody: DigitalOcean stores our data and files. MSG91 and Twilio send sign-in codes and urgent text messages. SendGrid sends email, and Expo sends notifications. Apple, Google, RevenueCat, Razorpay and Stripe handle payments. Each gets only what it needs for that job, and data may be handled outside your country.
privacy.locationTitle: Location, photos and your phone's contacts
privacy.locationBody: AYWO reads your location only while you run an SOS, and shares it only with the people that SOS goes to, until it ends. It reads your photos and contacts only when you choose one to add.
privacy.keepBody: For as long as your account or the family tree exists. When you delete your account, your name, number, photo and your own contact details go. Entries you added to a tree stay with that tree, because they belong to the family's history. Payment records are kept as long as the law requires.
privacy.rightsBody: You can see and correct your details, download a copy of your data, delete your account, withdraw consent and name someone to act for you. Complain to our Grievance Officer, {{grievanceOfficer}}, at {{grievanceEmail}}. Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you can also go to the Data Protection Board of India. Someone who is not on AYWO can use the takedown form.
privacy.childrenBody: AYWO isn't meant for anyone under 18 to use without a parent or guardian's consent. Families may record children in a tree. A parent or guardian can ask us to change or remove a child's details.
privacy.changesBody: When this policy changes in a way that matters, we will tell you in the app. The version above shows which one you are reading.
privacy.cookiesBody: The website keeps your sign-in and settings in your browser. We use no advertising or tracking cookies. When you pay on the website, Razorpay or Stripe may set their own cookies on their payment pages.
privacy.securityBody: Data travels encrypted, and access inside the app follows each tree's rules. Staff access is limited by role and recorded. No system is perfect: if a breach could affect you, we will tell you and the authorities as the law requires.

refunds.title: Return and refund policy
refunds.summaryBody: You can cancel AYWO Plus at any time. Your family tree stays free, whatever happens to a paid plan. Printed items are made just for you, so they are replaced or refunded if something is wrong with them. Payments made through Apple or Google are refunded by Apple or Google.
refunds.cancelBody: On the website, open Family plan and choose Cancel subscription. In the apps, use Manage subscription, which opens the App Store or Google Play. After a paid period has started, Plus stays until that period ends and then stops for the whole family, with no further charge. If you cancel during the free months, Plus stops straight away and you pay nothing. Deleting your account does not cancel a subscription, so cancel first.
refunds.webBody: Yearly plan: ask within {{refundDays}} days of a charge, including the first charge after the free months, for a full refund. After that, unused time is not refunded unless the law requires it. Monthly plan: a month that has started is not refunded. Whichever plan you use, we always refund a duplicate charge, or a charge taken after your cancellation was confirmed.
refunds.storesBody: Apple or Google took the payment, so only they can refund it, under their own rules. For Apple, go to reportaproblem.apple.com. For Google, go to your order history in Google Play. We cannot refund these ourselves, but we will help if you get stuck.
refunds.invitesBody: These are digital and ready to use straight away, so they are not refunded once used, unless the design did not work and we cannot fix it.
refunds.physicalBody: Each one is printed to order with your family's details, so it cannot be returned because you changed your mind. You can cancel for a full refund until printing starts.
refunds.damagedTitle: If something is wrong with your order
refunds.damagedBody: Tell us within {{damageDays}} days of delivery, with your order details and a photo. If the item is damaged, misprinted or not what you ordered, we will reprint it or refund you, at no cost, and you choose which. Keep the item until we reply; send it back only if we ask. A mistake in the details saved in your tree when you ordered is not a printing fault.
refunds.deliveryBody: Orders usually arrive within {{deliveryDays}} days of payment. Any delivery charge is shown before you pay. If an order is lost, or does not arrive well after that time, tell us and we will replace or refund it.
refunds.moneyBody: An approved refund goes back to the way you paid. We start it within {{refundWorkingDays}} working days. Your bank or card company may take a few more days to show it.
refunds.helpBody: Write to {{email}} or call {{phone}}. Please give the phone number on your AYWO account and your payment or order details. We reply to complaints within 48 hours and settle them within one month. If you are not happy with the answer, write to our Grievance Officer, {{grievanceOfficer}}, at {{grievanceEmail}}.

start.title: Getting started
start.whatA: AYWO, "Across Years, We're One", is a place for your family and friends. Build your family tree together, see how you are related in your own language, share memories, and stay in touch.
start.freeA: Yes. Your tree, all tree views, invites, alerts and SOS are always free. AYWO Plus is an optional paid plan that adds calling, chat and more.
start.signInA: With your mobile number and a one-time code sent by text message. There is no password to remember.
start.devicesA: On the website at {{website}}, and in the apps for Android and iPhone. Use the same mobile number and you will see the same family.
start.languageQ: Can I use it in my language?
start.languageA: Choose your language on the first screen, and change it any time from your profile. Relationship words, such as what you call an aunt, appear in your language too.
start.importingQ: I already have a family tree. Can I bring it in?
start.importingA: Yes. AYWO can import a Lighten file or a GEDCOM file, the common format most family tree programs can save.

tree.title: Your family tree
tree.whoSeesQ: Who can see my family tree?
tree.whoSeesA: Only the people it is shared with, at the level chosen for each of them. Nobody can find your tree by searching.
tree.rolesQ: What do Creator, Co-creator, Editor, Commenter and Viewer mean?
tree.rolesA: A Viewer can look. A Commenter can also comment. An Editor can add and correct people. A Co-creator helps run the tree. The Creator started the tree. These roles apply to that one tree only.
tree.noAccountQ: Can I add someone who isn't on AYWO?
tree.noAccountA: Yes, including relatives who have passed away. If a living relative joins later with the number you saved, AYWO asks them "Is this you?", so they can connect to their place in the tree.
tree.wrongQ: Something in the tree is wrong. What can I do?
tree.wrongA: If you are an Editor, Co-creator or Creator, correct it on the person's card. Otherwise, ask one of them. Relationship words are worked out automatically, and you can suggest a better word for your language.
tree.outsiderQ: What does someone see from a shared link?
tree.outsiderA: Names and photos only. Contact details are never shown on a shared link.
tree.downloadA: Yes, at any time, as a PDF picture of the tree or a GEDCOM file, depending on your role in that tree.

safety.title: Privacy and safety
safety.numberQ: Will people see my mobile number?
safety.numberA: Your sign-in number is never shown to anyone. Contact details on a person's card are shown only to those the tree's rules allow.
safety.removeQ: I was added to a tree without being asked. Can I be removed?
safety.removeA: Yes. Use "Added without asking? Ask us to remove it" on the first screen. You don't need an account. An AYWO Admin reviews each request and replies.
safety.sosA: Choose up to five contacts. When you start an SOS, they are alerted and can see your location until you stop it. A contact you added by typing their number can get a call. SOS depends on your phone and network, and does not replace emergency services: in danger, call your local emergency number first.
safety.sellQ: Do you sell my data or show ads?
safety.sellA: No. We don't sell your data, and we don't show advertising. See the Privacy policy for the details.
safety.childrenQ: Can children be in the tree?
safety.childrenA: Families may record children in a tree. Anyone under 18 needs a parent or guardian's consent to use AYWO, and a parent or guardian can ask us to change or remove a child's details.

plus.title: AYWO Plus and payments
plus.includesA: Call or WhatsApp anyone in the tree, family chat, groups and one-to-one messages, and reacting and replying on family moments.
plus.priceA: In India: {{monthlyIndia}} a month or {{yearlyIndia}} a year. Elsewhere: {{monthlyAbroad}} a month or {{yearlyAbroad}} a year. The price you pay is always shown before you buy, and store prices can differ slightly by country.
plus.trialA: Yes. The yearly plan gives you the first 2 months free. It then renews as a paid yearly plan unless you cancel before the free months end. The monthly plan starts straight away.
plus.familyQ: How many people does one plan cover?
plus.familyA: You and 5 family members. The person who pays adds members from Family plan.
plus.payA: In the apps: through the App Store or Google Play. On the website in India: UPI, debit card or credit card, through Razorpay. On the website elsewhere: cards or Apple Pay, through Stripe. We never see your card or bank details.
plus.cancelA: Any time, where you bought it: Family plan on the website, or Manage subscription in the app. Plus stays until the end of the period you paid for. Deleting your account does not cancel it.
plus.refundA: Yes, in the situations listed in our Return and refund policy. A payment made through Apple or Google is refunded by them.
plus.failedQ: I paid, but I don't see Plus. Should I pay again?
plus.failedA: No. It can take a few minutes to confirm. If Plus has not appeared after that, write to {{email}} with your payment details.

orders.title: Posters, books and invites
orders.whatA: A printed family tree poster, a printed family book and premium invite designs. Prices are shown before you pay.
orders.damagedQ: My order arrived damaged or wrong. What now?
orders.damagedA: Tell us within {{damageDays}} days of delivery, with a photo. We will reprint it or refund you, at no cost. See the Return and refund policy.

account.title: Your account
account.deleteQ: How do I delete my account?
account.deleteA: Open your profile, then Privacy and account, then Delete. It happens immediately, so download a copy first if you want one, and cancel any subscription. Your name, number and photo are removed. Entries you added to a tree stay with that tree.
